core_identity.short_form: Five-Color is all five colors present: breadth, coalition, synthesis, and every tool negotiated under constraint.
core_identity.summary: Five-Color / WUBRG is Vox Mana's controlled expression for full color access, coalition, synthesis, spectrum, and totality without turning those ideas into an official faction or superiority claim.
core_identity.philosophy: Five-Color asks what happens when every color is allowed to speak and none can pretend it is the whole answer. Its strength is breadth; its risk is dilution, contradiction, or goodstuff drift.
core_identity.central_tension: Five-Color can integrate every tool into one living plan, but it can also lose identity if breadth becomes mere accumulation.
core_identity.identity_frame: Use Five-Color as public-facing language and WUBRG as technical metadata. Keep all lore, Commander, and deck claims source-bound.

structure.primary_anchor: Commander color identity and official Five-Color product labeling
structure.non_faction_boundary: Five-Color / WUBRG is not an official faction, plane, civilization, guild, college, doctrine, or single personality.

great_tension.gift: Every color can contribute a needed answer, so the identity can solve problems through breadth rather than purity.
great_tension.shadow: If every tool is included without a reason, Five-Color collapses into unfocused goodstuff or false total mastery.
great_tension.boundary: This is Vox Mana synthesis and Commander-facing source interpretation, not official Wizards canon doctrine.

profile.overview: Five-Color / WUBRG is Vox Mana's controlled expression for all five colors present: breadth, coalition, synthesis, totality, and the responsibility to keep every included tool source-bound.
profile.philosophy: Five-Color believes the answer may need every color, but not every color at once and not every tool without a reason. White asks for structure, Blue for understanding, Black for agency, Red for motion, and Green for belonging; WUBRG is the negotiation among them.
profile.core_tension: Five-Color can hold every color in one plan, but it must resist becoming generic accumulation, false superiority, or unfocused goodstuff.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Domain, converge, sunburst, WUBRG costs or activations, multicolor payoffs, basic-land-type checks, and mana infrastructure can express Five-Color play, but individual cards and Commander claims remain manually verified support.
